entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: A Norse-mythology-inspired plane of ten realms bound to the World Tree, of prophecy and legend, mortals and monsters.

entities.name: World Tree
entities.description: The origin of all life on Kaldheim, whose branches can be seen in the sky of all ten realms.

entities.name: Ten Realms
entities.description: The ten realms of Kaldheim that constantly shift and move around the World Tree and can collide.

entities.name: Doomskar
entities.description: The epic collision of realms that causes earthquakes, destabilization, and chaos.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker who visits Kaldheim, a world of prophecy and legend.

entities.name: Vorinclex
entities.description: A Phyrexian creature that appears on a surprise card in the set.

entities.name: Gods of Kaldheim
entities.description: Gods who travel between the realms to do their bidding for peace, for bloodshed, or their amusement, and to whom all Kaldheim's peoples are supplicant.
